summary: Wetour Robotics Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting amendments to its memorandum and articles of association following a 100:1 share consolidation effective August 3, 2026. Shareholders approved at an EGM on February 27, 2026 a consolidation ratio between 2:1 and 100:1; directors set 100:1 on July 6, 2026. The M&A was filed with Cayman Islands Registrar on August 5, 2026. This is a routine corporate action to meet Nasdaq listing requirements, not a special situation with deal terms. No strategic event is implied; watch for potential future capital raising or reverse split effects.
